parts.html: The K-02 kitchen model brings together the warmth of natural wood textures, understated beige tones, and contemporary minimalist design. Its L-shaped layout with a kitchen island creates a refined living environment where visual simplicity meets everyday functionality.

The combination of veneered upper cabinet fronts and painted lower cabinets adds depth and character to the furniture composition. A coordinated solid-color finish maintains a clean, cohesive appearance, making the kitchen suitable for modern apartments and private residences.
The porcelain stoneware countertop complements the kitchen's contemporary aesthetic, providing a practical surface for food preparation and daily activities.

With a total linear length of 9 meters, the K-02 kitchen offers extensive cabinet space and integrated appliance placement. The island adds a separate functional surface while reinforcing the architectural character of the interior.

The kitchen incorporates carefully selected European furniture hardware. FREE FOLD Hafele lift systems provide convenient access to upper cabinets, while Hettich soft-close hinges and AvanTech YOU drawer systems contribute to effortless everyday use.
The cabinet construction uses 18 mm laminated chipboard, and furniture handles are included in the configuration.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for residential properties in Bratislava and Vienna.
The K-02 model can be customized to match your kitchen dimensions, appliance requirements, storage preferences, and interior design concept.

Our services cover kitchen planning, custom cabinet manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation. Additional equipment, including sinks, kitchen appliances, extractor hoods, and plumbing fixtures, can be selected according to the client's requirements.
Order your K-02 kitchen from DUMSKAYA DESIGN and create a personalized minimalist interior with quality materials and functional European hardware.
